title: Fins for a turn
hook: A fish can use more than its tail to move.

knows: Different fish can have different structures and behaviors.
doesNotKnow: The colored fin behind the head changes orientation in this schematic. Paired pectoral fins can help many fishes maneuver and stabilize; fin use depends on the species and movement. The curved arrow illustrates a possible turn, not a measured path.

misconception: The first imagined explanation must apply to this fish.
objective: The pictured fish adjusts a fin just behind its head. Which fins can help many fish maneuver?

claims.text: A fish can use more than its tail to move. The pictured fish adjusts a fin just behind its head. Which fins can help many fish maneuver?
